ar.ideas_intro: عندك فكرة تحسّن العمل؟ اكتبها هنا. كل فكرة تصل 50 تأييدًا لازم ترد عليها الإدارة خلال 14 يومًا.
ar.ideas_not_bonus: صندوق الأفكار لا علاقة له بالمكافأة.
ar.ideas_implemented_intro: هذه أفكار اقترحها زملاؤك ونفّذتها الشركة.
ar.idea_not_found: الفكرة غير موجودة أو لم تُنشر بعد
ar.idea_quota_left: باقي لك {n} من {limit} أفكار هذا الشهر.
ar.idea_quota_none: وصلت الحد: {limit} أفكار في الشهر. تقدر ترسل فكرة جديدة الشهر الجاي.
ar.idea_votes_to_go: باقي {n} تأييد حتى تلتزم الإدارة بالرد.
ar.idea_threshold_reached: وصلت الفكرة 50 تأييدًا: الإدارة ملزمة بالرد.
ar.idea_countdown_hint: الإدارة ترد خلال 14 يومًا من وصول الفكرة 50 تأييدًا.
ar.idea_waiting_review: الموارد البشرية تراجع فكرتك قبل نشرها (خلال يومين).
ar.idea_description_helper: لا تذكر أسماء زملاء ولا تهاجم أحدًا، وإلا ما تُنشر الفكرة.
ar.idea_named_help: اسمك يظهر لكل الموظفين مع الفكرة.
ar.idea_anonymous_help: اسمك ما يظهر لأي أحد، ولا للموارد البشرية. مدير النظام فقط يقدر يكشفه عند الإساءة، وكل كشف يُسجَّل.

ar.idea_similar_hint: إذا فكرتك موجودة، أيّدها بدل ما ترسلها من جديد.
ar.idea_review_notice: تراجع الموارد البشرية الفكرة خلال يومين قبل نشرها. المراجعة تمنع فقط الإساءة أو ذكر الزملاء.
ar.idea_err_idea_not_found: الفكرة غير موجودة أو لم تُنشر بعد.
ar.idea_err_idea_photo_invalid: تعذّر رفع الصورة. جرّب صورة ثانية.

en.ideas_subtitle: Suggest, and support your colleagues' ideas
en.ideas_intro: Have an idea that makes work better? Write it here. Every idea that reaches 50 supporters gets a management reply within 14 days.
en.ideas_not_bonus: The ideas box is not linked to the bonus.
en.ideas_empty_mine: You have not sent any idea yet
en.ideas_empty_hint: Be the first to suggest one.
en.ideas_implemented_hint: Employees' ideas that were carried out
en.ideas_implemented_intro: These are ideas your colleagues suggested and the company carried out.
en.idea_not_found: This idea does not exist or is not published yet
en.idea_quota_left: You can send {n} of {limit} ideas this month.
en.idea_quota_none: You reached the limit of {limit} ideas a month. You can send a new one next month.
en.idea_votes_to_go: {n} more supporters and management must reply.
en.idea_threshold_reached: The idea reached 50 supporters: management must reply.
en.idea_own_note: You cannot support your own idea.
en.idea_votes_closed: Support is closed for this idea.
en.idea_countdown_title: Time left for the management reply
en.idea_countdown_hint: Management replies within 14 days of the idea reaching 50 supporters.
en.idea_waiting_review: HR reviews your idea before it is published (within 2 days).
en.idea_review_rejected_reason: Your idea was not published. Reason: {reason}
en.idea_title_placeholder: Example: shades for the car park
en.idea_description_placeholder: Explain the idea and how it helps
en.idea_description_helper: Do not name colleagues or attack anyone, or the idea will not be published.
en.idea_named_help: Your name is shown to everyone with the idea.
en.idea_anonymous_help: Your name is hidden from everyone, HR included. Only the system admin can reveal it, for abuse, and every reveal is logged.
en.idea_photo_helper: A photo that shows the idea. Do not photograph colleagues.
en.idea_camera_denied: No camera permission. Turn it on in the phone settings.
en.idea_similar_hint: If your idea is already here, support it instead of sending it again.
en.idea_review_notice: HR reviews the idea within 2 days before publishing. Review only blocks insults or naming colleagues.
en.idea_sent: Your idea was sent; it is published after review
en.idea_error_title_short: The title is too short (at least 5 characters).
en.idea_error_title_long: The title is too long (120 characters at most).
en.idea_error_description_short: The description is too short (at least 20 characters).
en.idea_error_description_long: The description is too long (2000 characters at most).
en.idea_err_idea_monthly_limit: You reached the limit of 3 ideas a month.
en.idea_err_idea_own_vote: You cannot support your own idea.
en.idea_err_idea_voting_closed: Support is closed for this idea.
en.idea_err_idea_not_found: This idea does not exist or is not published yet.
en.idea_err_idea_photo_invalid: The photo could not be uploaded. Try another one.
en.idea_err_idea_title_invalid: The title must be 5 to 120 characters.
en.idea_err_idea_description_invalid: The description must be 20 to 2000 characters.
